text:
Before: tortellini with meat sauce (~300 g, ~500 kcal), mixed vegetables (~150 g, ~80 kcal), fruit salad of watermelon and apple (~200 g, ~90 kcal), and juice (~300 ml, ~130 kcal).

After: the tortellini and vegetables are fully eaten. The juice glass is gone from the tray, so I assume it was drunk. About 8 watermelon cubes remain, roughly 100 g, so the person ate about 100 g of the fruit (~50 kcal), including the apple pieces.

Totals eaten: 300 + 150 + 100 + 300 = 850 g, and 500 + 80 + 50 + 130 = 760 kcal.
